title: Drupal Meetup in Columbia - Monday, Aug 12, 6:00 PM

html:
The SC Drupal User Group meets the second Monday of every month at the IT-Ology building in Columbia, 1301 Gervais St, 2nd Floor.  http://it-ology.org Our next meeting will be Monday, Aug 12, at 6:00 pm. IT-Ology is on the 2nd floor. If you park in the garage and walk across the bridge, you will be there.

Please register / sign-up at http://www.meetup.com/SC-Drupal-Users-Group. If you have any suggestions for content, please let me know via a comment here or through the Meetup page.

Lullabot's Drupalize.Me team has agreed to sponsor our group with free access to Drupalize.me training videos on the day of our meetup. I would like to try this out and maybe watch a portion of a video on a particular topic. I have some ideas in mind but I'd love to hear from you. http://drupalize.me/blog/201306/wed-sponsor-your-user-group

See you there!
